---
title: "Flags of the World"
format: html
---

<style>
.flag-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}

.flag-grid figure {
  margin: 0;
  text-align: center;
}

.flag-grid img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
</style>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
flags <- sort(list.files(pattern = "^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]{3})?\\.png$"))
codes <- toupper(sub("\\.png$", "", flags))
items <- sprintf(
  '<figure><img src="%s" alt="Flag of %s"><figcaption>%s</figcaption></figure>',
  flags, codes, codes
)
cat('<div class="flag-grid">\n', paste(items, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n', sep = "")
```
